test_title: PYST 63: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given phrase.

Jump on the bandwagon

options.text: To oppose the idea of a group gaining popularity
To support ideas that are less popular
To join or support something which is gaining popularity

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The phrase **"Jump on the bandwagon"** means to join or support a particular activity, idea, or movement that is currently popular or gaining momentum. (किसी लोकप्रिय गतिविधि या विचार का समर्थन करना)

 

 
• **Example:** Many companies are jumping on the bandwagon of sustainability to attract environmentally conscious customers.

 

 
• This phrase is often used in contexts where individuals or groups start supporting something only because it is trending or becoming successful. (मौजूद चलन या लोकप्रियता के कारण समर्थन करना)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To oppose the idea of a group gaining popularity **(किसी लोकप्रिय समूह या विचार का विरोध करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The activist decided to oppose the idea of the new policy gaining popularity.

 

 
• **Option 2: To jump to a conclusion** (जल्दबाज़ी में निष्कर्ष निकालना): To make a decision or judgment without having all the necessary information.

 

 
• **Example:** Don't jump to conclusions without hearing both sides of the story.

 

 
• **Option 3: To support ideas that are less popular** (कम लोकप्रिय विचारों का समर्थन करना): Supporting something that is not widely accepted or trendy.

 

 
• **Example:** She always prefers to support ideas that are less popular and unconventional.
